title: Dinosaur Stomp ABC
hook: Build the body clue before you name the animal.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D dinosaur storybook, earthy greens and amber, rounded non-scary dinosaurs, museum-clean silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing reconstructed body plans from fossil evidence
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: grounded 4/4 with different motion pockets, not one stomp
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written anatomical comparisons with taxonomy boundaries
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: body clue -> recall beat -> target -> safe shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a low soft tom footprint followed by one dry woodblock click.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a low soft tom footprint followed by one dry woodblock click
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Replace the generic dinosaur stomp with a body-plan study: armor, beaks, tails, feet, wings, claws and posture produce different motions; fossils and volcano are evidence/context rather than animals.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares how prehistoric bodies were built to move, feed, defend or fly, with explicit corrections for pterosaurs and uncertain sound.
